name: prompt-874
image_purpose: Portrait lookbook reference for consistent identity, varied expressions, and coordinated casual styling.

prompt.project_info: Create a clean 3x3 portrait grid with one consistent approved adult fictional woman, varied expressions, pastel backgrounds, and coordinated casual fashion styling.
prompt.main_subject: One adult fictional East Asian-looking woman with consistent face structure, hair, skin tone, and natural makeup across all panels, styled in pastel casual garments including hoodie, tee, sweater, denim, and striped pieces.
composition_elements: Nine distinct head-and-shoulders or waist-up expressions ranging from calm and curious to playful and thoughtful.
Pastel pink, blue, yellow, lavender, and neutral backgrounds distributed across the grid.
Vary hoodie, tee, sweater, denim, and striped styling while preserving a coherent color palette.
Keep face scale, eye direction, and crop variations editorially balanced.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even beauty lighting with gentle pastel color fill, clean studio atmosphere, subtle shadows, and a friendly editorial tone.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-photorealistic portrait photography, realistic skin and hair texture, accurate facial anatomy, consistent identity across nine panels, crisp 3x3 grid, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic 3x3 expression portrait grid of one consistent adult fictional East Asian-looking woman, natural makeup and coherent hair, nine varied calm playful thoughtful expressions, pastel pink blue yellow lavender and neutral backgrounds, coordinated hoodie tee sweater denim and striped casual styling, soft even studio beauty light, realistic skin and hair, editorial consistency, no text, no watermark.
